fields.name: image_size
fields.title: Image Size
fields.description: The size of the generated image. Supports preset names, explicit {width, height}, or 'auto' to let the model pick the best size. Concrete sizes must have both dimensions as multiples of 16, max edge 3840px, aspect ratio <= 3:1, total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400.

fields.name: quality
fields.title: Quality
fields.description: Quality for the generated image. Higher settings increase detail, latency, and token usage. Use 'auto' to let the model choose.

fields.name: output_compression
fields.title: Output Compression
fields.description: Compression level from 0 to 100. Only supported when output_format is 'jpeg' or 'webp'.
